theorem shiftJumps_of_nonJump {instr : Instr}
    (h : ¬instr.IsJump) (offset : ℕ) : instr.shiftJumps offset = instr :=
proof_text:
by
  cases instr with
  | Z _ | S _ | T _ _ => rfl
  | J _ _ _ => exact absurd trivial h
gold_proof:
by
  cases instr with
  | Z _ | S _ | T _ _ => rfl
  | J _ _ _ => exact absurd trivial h

proof_text:
by

  | J _ _ _ => exact absurd trivial h
  | _ => trivial

  | _ => trivial

statement: theorem capJump_Z (len n : ℕ) : (Z n).capJump len = Z n :=
theorem capJump_S (len n : ℕ) : (S n).capJump len = S n :=
theorem capJump_T (len m n : ℕ) : (T m n).capJump len = T m n :=

theorem capJump_J (len m n q : ℕ) :
    (J m n q).capJump len = J m n (min q len) :=

theorem JumpsBoundedBy.capJump (len : ℕ) (instr : Instr) :
    (instr.capJump len).JumpsBoundedBy len :=
proof_text:
by
  cases instr with
  | J _ _ q => exact Nat.min_le_right q len
  | _ => trivial
gold_proof:
by
  cases instr with
  | J _ _ q => exact Nat.min_le_right q len
  | _ => trivial

theorem capJump_idempotent (len : ℕ) (instr : Instr) :
    (instr.capJump len).capJump len = instr.capJump len :=
proof_text:
by
  cases instr with
  | Z | S | T => rfl
  | J m n q => simp [capJump]
gold_proof:
by
  cases instr with
  | Z | S | T => rfl
  | J m n q => simp [capJump]

theorem mem_maxRegister {p : Program} {instr : Instr} (h : instr ∈ p) :
    instr.maxRegister ≤ p.maxRegister :=
proof_text:
by
  unfold maxRegister
  rw [List.foldl_map.symm, ←List.foldr_eq_foldl]
  exact List.le_max_of_le' 0 (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨instr, h, rfl⟩) (le_refl _)
gold_proof:
by
  unfold maxRegister
  rw [List.foldl_map.symm, ←List.foldr_eq_foldl]
  exact List.le_max_of_le' 0 (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨instr, h, rfl⟩) (le_refl _)
